summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Coop Overwatch. All 17 pytest backend tests pass covering dashboard, farms/sheds/batches CRUD, breeds, breed curves, reading ingestion with anomaly-triggered alerts/decisions, ack, decision approval, policies, and Mother Hen LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent key). Frontend: dashboard, filter buttons, shed detail (Simulate + Ask Mother Hen → amber panel with LLM summary rendered), Batches list, Mother Hen policies+tabs, Alerts (ack buttons present), and Settings forms all load and render correctly.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on first render; chart appears fine after animation but console warning suggests missing min height for ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: Optional: align data-testids with review spec: MotherHen tab is `tab-auto` (review said `tab-auto-applied`), BatchList uses `batch-row-{id}` (review said `batch-card-`), Settings ingest select uses `ingest-shed` (review said `ingest-shed-select`). Functionality works, only test-id naming differs.
Optional: set explicit min-height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer to silence width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Batch closing behaviour verified: creating a new batch on a shed correctly closes previous active batch (server.py create_batch).
Alert + Decision pipeline triggered only on POST /api/readings (as expected). Seed inserts raw readings without pipeline — documented in review, works as intended.
MongoDB `_id` correctly excluded via projections {"_id": 0} across list endpoints.
Mother Hen deep_analysis returns {'summary': 'Insufficient data...'} when no active batch/latest reading — soft-fail without HTTP error, good UX.

Ingest endpoint returns bare Reading object (no wrapping in {reading, findings}). If the frontend needs findings it must re-fetch /alerts and /decisions. Currently ShedDetail does this via reloads — works.
seed_data_creation: None additional; relies on backend startup seed (2 farms, 5 sheds, 5 batches, historical readings). Tests create/delete TEST_ prefixed farms/sheds and additional batches/readings on sheds[0] as part of flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py. pytest.ini has xdist auto by default; use `pytest ... -o addopts=''` to disable parallelism when tests share mutable state (e.g., closing/reopening batches on sheds[0]). LLM analyze endpoint takes ~5–15s; use timeout=90. To trigger the alert pipeline, POST /api/readings with anomalous values (temp_c=40, ammonia_ppm=50).
